_comment: Lane rule table of India (left-hand traffic), written by Claude on 2026-11-16 from the accepted passages (Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations, 2017). IRC:35 (the road-marking code) is not in the pack. Used only to prefill the labeling tool; never used to score.

boundary.note: A kerb is the physical edge of the carriageway (project convention, as for CN and US).
Lane marked for a class of vehicles or a special purpose: no other vehicle shall be driven in it (prohibited, project convention).
Change lanes only after giving a proper signal.
The driver shall not drive on or over a single longitudinal solid line.
A yellow or white solid line shall not be crossed.

arrow:right.note: Left-hand traffic: a U-turn is made from the right-hand side of the road, like a right turn. A right arrow does not by itself prohibit a U-turn; decide per image (labeling convention, contested). U-turn: allowed with this arrow unless a no-U-turn marking or sign is visible (owner, 2026-11-17).

arrow:straight_right.note: Left-hand traffic: a U-turn is made from the right-hand side of the road, like a right turn. A right arrow does not by itself prohibit a U-turn; decide per image (labeling convention, contested). U-turn: allowed with this arrow unless a no-U-turn marking or sign is visible (owner, 2026-11-17).

arrow:merge_left.note: Merge arrow: my lane ends ahead; the advice is to merge. The change actions come from the boundaries.

arrow:merge_right.note: Merge arrow: my lane ends ahead; the advice is to merge. The change actions come from the boundaries.

area:grid.note: Yellow box: do not stop in it (advice).

area:channelizing.note: Painted traffic island: do not drive on it.
